title: TimesNet: Frequency-domain decomposition improves forecasting on strongly periodic signals in ETTh1, Weather
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using TimesNet, a 2D-convolutional periodicity-aware model. On ETTh1, Weather, at horizon 336, Frequency-domain decomposition improves forecasting on strongly periodic signals in ETTh1, Weather. TimesNet reduces MSE by 11% over time-domain baselines on ETTh1. We discuss two limitations: Comparison omits linear baselines that recent work has shown to be competitive. The training corpus is limited to a single domain, so cross-domain robustness is not established. Future work should address analysing attention weights to test the interpretability hypothesis. and reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
